questions.q: When a memory container generates a session summary, what is the default maximum number of words in that summary, and how can I change it?

questions.grading: Correct: 10 words, set through the session object's max_summary_size. Wrong: any other default. Partial: gives 10 without saying how to change it.

questions.q: For agentic memory consolidation, how many similar existing memories does a container retrieve by default to make ADD/UPDATE/DELETE decisions, and what is the upper limit?

questions.grading: Correct: default 5, max 10. Wrong: any other values. Partial: only one of the two numbers.

questions.q: Which function-calling interface values can I set for the model in the tool that fills agentic search templates?

questions.grading: Correct: all three values. Partial: one or two of them. Wrong: lists values not in the passage, such as bedrock/converse/deepseek_r1.

questions.q: What restrictions apply to the newer multimodal conversational agent type regarding memory, streaming, and hooks?
questions.expect: The `conversational_v2` agent supports only the `agentic_memory` memory type, so `conversation_index` is incompatible. It does not support streaming responses. It does not support agent execution hooks or context management.
questions.grading: Correct: all three limitations (agentic_memory only, no streaming, no hooks/context management). Partial: only some of them. Wrong: says conversation_index is supported.

questions.q: Which release added the tool that fills agentic search templates, and what must I enable before I can use it?
questions.expect: The `SearchTemplateFillTool` was added in 3.10.0 and is experimental. Set `plugins.ml_commons.agentic_search_template_enabled` to `true`. The tool is not available when multi-tenancy is enabled. You also need to register agentic search templates and an externally hosted model whose connector request body includes the required placeholders.
questions.grading: Correct: names release 3.10.0 and the agentic_search_template_enabled setting. Partial: only the version or only the setting. Wrong: a different version or setting.

questions.q: Since which version does OpenSearch support the Vertex AI connector protocol, and on version 3.10 do I still have to add the Vertex AI host to the trusted endpoints myself?

questions.grading: Correct: introduced in 3.9, and the default includes the host from 3.10 (manual addition only if the setting was customized). Wrong: says it is needed on 3.10 with default settings, or gives a different introduction version. Partial: only one half.

questions.q: Which agent types can report per-call token consumption, how is it turned on, and in which release did that arrive?
questions.expect: Token usage tracking arrived in 3.6. Conversational agents and plan-execute-reflect agents support it (the 3.6.0 notes also list AG_UI agents). Set `include_token_usage` to `true` when executing the agent, and the response includes a `token_usage` output.
questions.grading: Correct: 3.6, the include_token_usage=true parameter, and both conversational and plan-execute-reflect agents. Partial: only one agent type or missing the version. Wrong: a different version or parameter.

questions.q: What ML Commons features were listed in the 3.10.0 release notes?

questions.grading: Correct: all five items. Partial: three or four of them. Wrong: includes items from other releases or enhancements as features.

questions.q: Which ML Commons features in 3.8.0 were about MCP, gRPC, or memory retention?
questions.expect: MCP support for Flow and Conversational Flow agents (#4776); a REST API to list all tools on an MCP server (#4705); gRPC streaming for ML prediction and agent execution (#4790); memory retention policy data model, pinned field and API wiring (#4914); memory retention job, cluster defaults and hardening (#4918).

questions.q: In hybrid search over agentic long-term memory, I want the keyword part weighted at 0.25. What must the semantic weight be, and what is the default when I set neither?

questions.q: A connector uses the default client configuration and is served by 4 nodes. How many concurrent connections can OpenSearch open to the remote service at most?

questions.grading: Correct: 120, with the 30 default and the multiplication by node count. Wrong: 30 or any other number.

questions.q: Is there a cluster-level setting or hard upper limit that caps the `max_iteration` value for conversational_v2 agents?

questions.q: What is the default run interval, in hours, of the memory retention job, and what is the default retention duration per memory type?

questions.q: On OpenSearch 3.10, if a local model is deployed on only some of the eligible nodes, will the nodes that have it still serve predictions, or are the requests rejected?

questions.q: What is the default value of the Flow Framework setting that caps how many steps a single workflow can contain?

questions.q: When paginating hybrid query results, what upper limit applies to the pagination_depth value, and when is it mandatory?

questions.q: For Faiss binary quantization, which quantization bit widths can use asymmetric distance computation, and which can use random rotation?

gold_changes.question: What is the default run interval, in hours, of the memory retention job, and what is the default retention duration per memory type?

old.expect: The documentation passages do not give a default retention job interval or default retention durations. They only say `retention_policy` requires `plugins.ml_commons.memory.retention_enabled` to be true.
